test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select "No substitution required".

The White man had to swallow his bombast and __have completed the journey in mortified__.
solution: The correct answer is '1' i.e. complete the journey in mortification .
